title: Inspect automatic silence in review history
steps: Inspect the loaded pending flagged post and author icon, scrolling slightly to frame Timeline & notes.
Open the flagged author's user card to inspect the current silence and reason.
Dismiss the user card and open the Yes action dropdown.
Choose Delete post and inspect the updated review status and timeline.

video_guide.summary: Compare the automatic-silence entry with the author card and the later deletion and approval entries.

chapters.note: The pending review’s timeline includes Author silenced automatically with a relative time and Silenced automatically beneath it.

chapters.label: Open the flagged author’s user card

chapters.note: The casey_review card says This user is silenced and Reason: Silenced automatically.

chapters.label: Dismiss the user card and open the Yes menu

chapters.note: The Yes menu includes Delete post and notes that the author stays silenced.
The approved review’s timeline places Author silenced automatically above Post deleted by morgan_review and Approved by morgan_review.
The approved review still shows the separate automatic-silence, deletion and approval entries.
